hints.title: Complementary Target Lookup
hints.text: For any integer x, matching partners with absolute difference k must equal either x minus k or x plus k.

hints.title: Single Pass Frequency Counter
hints.text: Iterate across elements while recording seen counts in a hash table or frequency array.

hints.title: Accumulate Pair Counts
hints.text: Add occurrences of x minus k and x plus k seen so far, then increment frequency of current element x.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter

class Solution:
    def countKDifference(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        freq = Counter()
        ans = 0
        for x in nums:
            ans += freq[x - k] + freq[x + k]
            freq[x] += 1
        return ans
```

complexity.time: O(N) single pass through array of length N
complexity.space: O(U) where U is the number of distinct values in nums
complexity.notes: Hash table lookups take amortized O(1) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Double loop takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash table consumes linear memory to achieve linear running time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should solve in one pass using complementary hash map counting.
